card: Duckling = बत्तख का बच्चा। -let या -ette लगने से चीज़ का छोटा रूप या जानवर का बच्चा बनता है: pig → piglet (सूअर का बच्चा), book → booklet (छोटी किताब)।
Duckling = battakh ka bachcha. -let ya -ette lagne se cheez ka chhota roop ya jaanwar ka bachcha banta hai: pig → piglet (suar ka bachcha), book → booklet (chhoti kitaab).
Duckling = a baby duck. -let or -ette makes a smaller thing or a baby creature: pig → piglet, book → booklet.

card: बीती बात के लिए क्रिया का दूसरा रूप: win → won, hear → heard, seem → seemed, wait → waited। ‘has’ के बाद तीसरा रूप: has won।
Beeti baat ke liye kriya ka doosra roop: win → won, hear → heard, seem → seemed, wait → waited. ‘has’ ke baad teesra roop: has won.
For the past, use the past form: win → won, hear → heard, seem → seemed, wait → waited. After ‘has’, use the third form: has won.

card: Prepositions छोटे शब्द हैं जो जगह या तरीका बताते हैं: on (ऊपर), in (अंदर), into (अंदर की तरफ़ जाते हुए), across (आर-पार), with (के साथ), to (की ओर), by (से, जैसे by bus)।
Prepositions chhote shabd hain jo jagah ya tareeka bataate hain: on (upar), in (andar), into (andar ki taraf jaate hue), across (aar-paar), with (ke saath), to (ki or), by (se, jaise by bus).
Prepositions are small words for place or way: on, in, into, across, with, to, by (as in by bus).
